about_the_game:
This text-based adventure game is dedicated to immersing you in an epic story of oppression, roaring, liberation, and rebirth.

Background:

This shared history, written by the native 西帕（Supa） people and humanity, has peacefully entered its second the comfortable, free, and hedonistic human cities, lies the reflection of civilization's dark side—woven from violent crime, bloody live streams, drugs, and slavery.Countless people harbor dreams, hoping to raise the banner of order.So too do starving slaves cry out, their own blood fueling the torch in their fight for truth.The vast majority of them will be crushed—sacrificed so that someone, somewhere, may one day touch the hope they could not.

You will step into the shoes of several of these individuals: the most naive; the most brilliant; the most helpless; the most desperate.At various points in time, you will glimpse the two worlds crushing against one another in the cracks between reality and the virtual.

And you will bear witness to the towering "House of Cards" as it rises, and see firsthand what a terrifying shadow it casts.

Story:

In the first story, you play as an amnesiac father, struggling for survival at a card table where the stakes are life and death.A young woman named "钟声（Bell）," who calls herself "the Manager," will accompany you, offering strategies for your survival.But trapped in her own shadow, she seems to seek an impossible answer from you.And by the story's conclusion, she will proclaim the birth of an "infant."

In the second story, you will play as a cheerful but shockingly amateurish native police officer.You will go deep behind enemy lines with a senior partner who looks as if he's never smiled in his life...

Hopefully, you will both make it home alive.

Gameplay:

The game features a rich variety of gameplay. At different points in time, you'll feel as if you're playing entirely different games—

·You will gamble with your life at a game of 21;

·You will endure a game of roulette that you crafted yourself;

·You will conceal your life as a spy under the guise of managing a bakery;

·You will share your wisdom with children who are eager for knowledge;

·You will get to raise one seriously cool lizard;

·You will attempt to comprehend the essence of destiny alongside a diviner...

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of firearms, violence, human organs, drug abuse, alcohol abuse, and self-harm. Player discretion is advised.

short_description: A text-based RPG adventure. Uncover an epic story of decay and rebirth in a new world, 200 years after humanity's arrival. Guide multiple protagonists through an immersive narrative, diverse gameplay, and a dynamic art style. An unforgettable experience awaits!
